mainEntity.name: Is Allahabad different from Prayagraj for travel planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Allahabad is the former name of Prayagraj; itineraries cover the same city with emphasis on Sangam rituals and heritage landmarks.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of a Tempo Traveller from Varanasi to Allahabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Varanasi to Allahabad (Prayagraj) 12-seater tempo traveller is ₹5,875 one-way and ₹6,750 for a same-day round trip. The 17-seater is ₹6,375 one-way (₹7,750 return), 26-seater is ₹7,250 (₹8,750 return), and Force Urbania is ₹8,125 (₹9,250 return).

mainEntity.name: Can we include Anand Bhavan and Khusro Bagh in one day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A 7:00 AM start allows Sangam rituals, Bade Hanumanji, Anand Bhavan, Khusro Bagh, and Cathedral of All Saints before evening return.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with priests for Sangam snan?

acceptedAnswer.text: We partner with vetted pandas near government ghat who disclose dakshina upfront to keep the ritual transparent.
